import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { artist } from "./artist";
import { track } from "./track";

export const album = defineTable("album", {
    columns: {
        albumId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        title: col.varchar(160).notNull(),
        artistId: col.integer().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        artist: rel.belongsTo(() => artist, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        track: rel.hasMany(() => track)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
